answer: Cheap names arrive like foam on an ocean, so this ledger ignores surface glitter and measures a core sample. Each applicant locks a bond, then runs a unique, non-parallelizable replay task whose output hash must match three independently scheduled re-executions. A pretty but hollow claim is like a loose opal: easy to display, worthless as proof. Only a result that hardens the way basalt hardens under pressure (same hash, same timing envelope, no shared sandboxes) unlocks vote weight. Cloned fleets collide on the replay or pay full compute for every name, and a mismatch slashes the bond.
